title: Furin sustains tumor-promoting signals in KRAS- and BRAF-mutated colorectal cancer by engaging the TGF-β1-COX-2 axis in a reciprocal regulatory network
task: Characterize Furin-mediated TGF-β1-COX-2 axis in KRAS/BRAF-mutant colorectal cancer
key_results: Furin inhibition suppressed tumor growth, reduced angiogenesis, and enhanced CD8⁺ T cell infiltration; KRAS/BRAF-mutant organoids with impaired Furin showed increased chemotherapy sensitivity; Furin-TGF-β1-COX-2 establishes reciprocal feed-forward loop; Furin/KRAS/BRAF/TGF-β1/COX-2 expression positively correlates in CRC patient samples
comments: Identifies Furin as pivotal oncogenic regulator with therapeutic potential, but mechanism of CD8⁺ T cell infiltration enhancement requires further mechanistic clarification.

inputs: Furin, KRAS, BRAF, TGF-β1, COX-2 expression levels

hypotheses.hypothesis: Furin inhibition blocks TGF-β1 and IGF-1R signaling in KRAS/BRAF-mutant CRC
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Furin inhibition suppresses IGF-1R and TGF-β1 precursor maturation/signaling

hypotheses.hypothesis: COX-2 elevation by TGF-β1 creates reciprocal loop enhancing Furin expression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; COX-2 overexpression elevates TGF-β1, which in turn enhances Furin expression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Furin inhibition sensitizes KRAS/BRAF-mutant organoids to standard chemotherapies
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; increased sensitivity to 5-FU and irinotecan in both; oxaliplatin sensitivity only in KPN organoids

comments: Practical tool addresses long-standing need for localized FAP manipulation, though long-term durability and immune responses to AAV require further investigation.

outputs: promoter activity in FAPs vs other cell types

hypotheses.hypothesis: Truncated Pdgfra promoter (826 bp) provides higher expression than full-length (2.2 kb)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 826 bp variant selected for subsequent experiments

hypotheses.hypothesis: AAV5 serotype achieves superior FAP specificity compared to AAV8
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; AAV5 with 826 bp Pdgfra promoter optimal for FAP targeting

title: Fibroblast activation protein-targeted near-infrared labeling of cancer-associated fibroblasts in a non-small-cell lung cancer tumor microenvironment

comments: Stromal-targeted approach provides tumor-subtype-agnostic strategy, though clinical translation requires assessment of real-time intraoperative imaging performance and surgeon guidance integration.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FAP targeting avoids off-target binding to normal lung tissue

title: Hybrid variational quantum-classical data assimilation for numerical weather prediction using Lorenz system benchmarks
